notes: Native firmware 0.1.21 — THE TFT-PUSH CRASH FIX: every display write used uart_write_bytes, which BLOCKS when the display's TX ring is full. The display's program (the new TFT) doesn't drain the ring fast enough on some pages, so the retained-message burst at MQTT connect filled the ring, the write blocked inside the interrupt context, and the 300ms interrupt watchdog aborted the chip. uart_tx_chars writes WITHOUT blocking — the overflow is dropped, the display catches up on its own. Carries all prior fixes.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
